questions.prompt: What is the primary difference between `cargo run` and `cargo build`?

options.a: `cargo run` only executes an existing binary without compiling
options.b: `cargo run` recompiles the project if source files changed, then executes the resulting binary
options.c: They are exact alias commands for the same underlying action
